sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands: consular visa information
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Washington, D.C.
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Embassy page identifies itself as the Republic of the Marshall Islands Embassy's consular information service and directs travelers to the current visa categories.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens from ALL OTHER countries not listed in A or B above must apply for visa PRIOR to traveling.

sources.title: Republic of the Marshall Islands Division of Immigration: Border Control
sources.publisher: Division of Immigration, Republic of the Marshall Islands
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Division of Immigration Border Control page publishes the territorial border unit's current entry requirements and advance-visa instruction.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Non-Exempt Visa Countries must possess a prior entry visa before entering the RMI.

sources.title: Republic of the Marshall Islands Immigration: visa exemption/waiver and arrival summary
sources.publisher: Division of Immigration, Ministry of Justice, Immigration and Labor, Republic of the Marshall Islands
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Immigration site still links this Division-issued ordinary-passport schedule, but the document itself says it is as of March 2024.
sources.supportingExcerpt: SUMMARY OF COUNTRIES ENTITLED FOR VISA EXEMPTION/WAIVER OR VISA ON ARRIVAL. As of March 2024.
